scenarios.name: agents-crud
scenarios.about: an agent is created with its principal, normalised scopes (trimmed name, deduplicated and sorted scopes); get and list read it; a rename and a scope change are updates; disabling twice keeps the first disabled_at; enabling clears it; an empty patch writes nothing

scenarios.name: agents-refusals
scenarios.about: an unknown scope is unknown_scope and a human-only scope is scope_not_grantable (the first offender in input order decides, on create and on update); a blank name and an unknown field are validation errors; an unknown agent is 404; nothing is written for any of them

error.message: scope not grantable to an agent: members:read
Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters
scope not grantable to an agent: agents:write

scenarios.name: api-keys-issue-revoke
scenarios.about: a key is issued once with its plaintext (vk_ + prefix of 11 characters), the event and every read carry neither the plaintext nor the hash; list filters by agent; revoke stamps revoked_at and updated_at with the unit clock and emits api_key.revoked; revoking again returns the same record with no event; a disabled agent may be issued a key

scenarios.name: api-keys-refusals
scenarios.about: a key for an unknown agent is invalid_reference; an expiry at or before the unit clock is a validation error; an unknown key cannot be revoked (404); an unknown field is refused; nothing is written for any of them

error.message: a referenced record does not exist
expires_at must be in the future
expires_at must be in the future

scenarios.name: memberships-read
scenarios.about: memberships are read-only: list, the role and user_id filters, get; an unknown id is 404; there is no write route

scenarios.name: users-read
scenarios.about: users are listed (live members only, keyset by id) and read by id; an unknown id and an id that is not a UUID are 404; a pagination step shows the cursor
